title: Count Number of Nice Subarrays
description: Given an array of integers, count the number of continuous subarrays that contain exactly k odd numbers.

steps.note: Initialize prefixMap with count 0 having 1 occurrence
oddCount(2) - k(2) = 0. prefixMap[0] is 1. res becomes 1
oddCount(2) - k(2) = 0. prefixMap[0] is 1. res becomes 2
